new_packages.label: לֵב וְחָלָל וְחָכְמָה
new_packages.reason: This is the most central conceptual cluster in Torah 49 — the Rebbe's foundational teaching about the heart as the chalal panui, the vessel of divine wisdom, and the site of creation. All proposed nodes share the essential nature of 'the heart as the creative void that mirrors the primordial chalal panui of creation.' Torah 49's radical innovation is the equation: 'the human heart in its tzimtzum state IS the chalal panui of creation, and through it the midot/worlds are revealed.' The heart, the divine wisdom within it (חכמה שבלב), the good thoughts that constitute that wisdom (מחשבות טובות), the yetzer tov that those thoughts ARE, the צוּר לְבָבִי (the heart-as-sculptor-of-midot), and the chalal panui of creation itself — all are identified as the same reality from different angles. The midot/worlds are the manifestation of this chalal. This domain is the POSITIVE heart-wisdom domain, the foundation of all avodah in this Torah. It requires the additions listed in torah_49_additions.json (additions 1-6).

new_packages.label: יֵצֶר הָרָע וְטִפְּשׁוּת הַלֵּב
new_packages.label_en: The Evil Inclination and the Dullness of the Heart
new_packages.reason: This is the evil mirror of Package 'torah_49_pkg_new_lev'. The same heart that can be the chalal panui of creation — when corrupted — becomes the closed, blocked, orlat-lev that destroys creation and corrupts the midot. Torah 49 §א explicitly constructs this mirror: 'ויצר' in Bereshit is written with two yuds = two yetzarim — one good (good thoughts = chokhma shebalev) and one evil (evil thoughts = yetzer hara = stupidity = arlat lev). The Rebbe equates: evil thoughts (מחשבות רעות) = yetzer hara = the stupidity/dullness of the heart (טפשות הלב) = the arlat-lev (the blocked heart). When a person thinks evil thoughts, 'he plugs the chalal of the heart' — making the heart impermeable (arlat lev = blocked = cannot receive midot). This corrupts creation itself. All nodes are expressions of the same evil domain: the heart's capacity to be closed, stupid, and blocking — the anti-wisdom that prevents the manifestation of midot/worlds.

new_packages.label: הַצַּדִּיק וְהַשֶּׁמֶשׁ
new_packages.reason: Torah 49 §ז (lines 69-82) develops a distinct domain about the tzaddik as the sun whose light/revelation depends entirely on Israel. The Tzaddik IS the sun (explicit bechina: 'הצדיק נקרא שמש'). The tzaddik's rising/setting = succession of tzaddikim. The ohel (tent = the tzaddik's shining, from 'לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ שָׂם אֹהֶל בָּהֶם' — 'ohel = his shining, like behilo nero'). Israel = the vehicle of the tzaddik's revelation ('bahhem' = through them = through Israel). The chuppah = the cover/concealment that hides the tzaddik when Israel enters foreign wisdoms. This constitutes an independent domain: the tzaddik-as-sun and the conditions for his revelation-concealment. Requires at minimum the tzaddik=shemesh addition. With at least 3 bechina statements (tzaddik=shemesh; ohel=shining; chuppah=cover), it qualifies for independent package status if the additions are accepted.

notes: Three new packages are proposed. The first two (torah_49_pkg_new_lev and torah_49_pkg_evil_lev) are the most significant: they represent the Torah's primary theoretical domain (the heart/chalal/chokhma cluster) which is completely absent from the current dataset for reference 49. This is the largest gap found in this Torah's bechina graph — the foundational cluster is unrepresented despite being the explicit backbone of the entire teaching. The third package (torah_49_pkg_tzaddik) is conditional on confirming bechina status for the §ז nodes. The two heart-packages together constitute 11 nodes and 9 bechina edges, all with explicit bechina language in the source text. The teaching's structural argument in Torah 49 is: [heart/chalal/chokhma → midot/malkhut] ← [eitza] ← [tzimtzum of heart] ← [good thoughts/yetzer tov]. The new heart packages capture the BECHINA skeleton of that domain; the eitza edges (already in dataset: id 2511, 2512, 25738, 25749 etc.) capture the CAUSAL flow between the domains.
